June 28, 1985 - In the air again. The final operation on Everon is going well; the Russians have been pushed back to the South, and there's no way they hold their positions for any length of time. Our tanks are about to attack, and they're counting on our support.

We have two Cobras on this job. I'll be heading towards Saint Pierre from North-West, with Davies coming from North-East, while the tanks will be in the middle, on the move from Levie through Durras to Saint Pierre. 

In all the excitement, I haven't thought about Sally for several days now.
Air Assault
Follow your flight plan, which takes you over Morton and Durras to Saint Pierre.
Support NATO's tank force, designated Zulu and Foxtrot, to ensure the city is liberated.
Return to base.

It's mopping-up time, Captain Nicholls. Today we clear all remaining Russian forces from Everon.

The Russian anti-aircraft forces have been destroyed and their helicopters are back on Kolgujev. Enemies have been spotted near Saint Pierre and Vernon only.

Climb aboard your Cobra, which is parked at its field base. Your call sign is November One.
